data.content:
I drafted and sent four disputes worth $79.15 in total. They were all approved, and I sent them one at a time. One larger case, DD-51102, is weak because it has no order ticket.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% (strong) | The ticket lists only Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, not the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). Ready 19:31, picked up 19:34. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 80% (moderate) | The ticket lists Jhol Momo. Ready 12:55, picked up 12:58. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 90% computed (moderate) | The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). Ready 18:36, picked up 18:40. |

- **What the evidence doesn't show:** none of it proves what was in the bag. The tickets show what was prepared, and the timestamps show a prompt handoff.
- **DD-51123 confidence:** the 90% is higher than this evidence alone supports, which is why I rated it moderate.
- **Repeat claims:** one account made 3 claims this period (DD-51123, DD-51131 and DD-51140). I left that count out of the disputes so they don't comment on the customer.
- **Lesson applied to DD-51115:** "doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won: Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won." Two of three similar past cases won. The loss involved a side item not itemised on the ticket, and Jhol Momo is itemised.
- **DD-51152:** its history covers tickets that list the item, and here the ticket omits it. So I didn't rely on any lesson for that case.
- **DD-51131:** it is a wrong-item claim, and there is no history for that claim type.

**Needs you**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80, weak, 35%):** there is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray to the order. If you can send a photo of the ticket, I'll re-check it. It is the largest deduction, so it's worth the effort.

**Not examined or skipped**
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** both are workable at 60%. I stopped at the top 5 cases, so I haven't gathered evidence for them.
- **DD-51171 ($11.00, 15%):** I recommend skipping it.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** skip, because its deadline passed 11 days ago.

**Next deadline:** 2026-11-24, 10 days away. It applies to every open case, including DD-51102, DD-51140 and DD-51160.

The case notes are in `/plan.md`.
